changelog:
**Channels save immediately.** Channel changes are stored first and schedule generation continues in the background, so creating or editing a channel no longer blocks the configuration page.

**Collection sources are fully supported.** Collections selected through title search are treated as real channel content, and the library source picker includes a search field for large libraries.

**YouTube and language UI fixes.** YouTube sources retain their thumbnails, and the duplicate configuration-language control has been removed.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
